notes.title: Star Survivor Has Reached Full Release!
notes.notes:
🛠️Commander's attention, please! I'm happy to bring you the official content update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/503a6668494a0b96e360e512668f6a21cf4f95f0.jpg

New Features
Added 2 new ships: RX91 and PMT34, featuring active skills that can be used by accumulating energy.
Added 4 new basic weapon cards and 2 new weapon combo cards.
Added ship skins: Christmas skin from the mobile version (although it's three months early, Merry Christmas!).
Added complete German localization.

Other Notable Changes
[Asteroids] In Campaign mode, if there are Asteroids-related tasks, the refresh rate of Asteroids will increase, and the first appearance time of meteor showers is modified to 3 minutes, followed by every 3 minutes.
[Controller] Fixed the lag issue with controller operations and added a number of features originally missing from controllers (selection, switching, inability to exit, etc.).
[Localization] Fixed various language text display abnormalities (such as text exceeding the frame).

Bug Fixes

[Monster] Fixed an issue where the boss would not attack in some situations.
[Monster] Fixed an issue where the Hatchery Queen and Void Worm had 0 health in Challenge mode.
[Monster] Fixed an issue with the abnormal display of the Gas Overlord model.
[Achievements] Fixed an issue where the achievement timer was halved after selecting Quick mode.
[Ship] Fixed an issue with the skill timer of RX91&PMT34.
[Ship] Fixed an issue where RX91&PMT34 didn't have initial equipment.
[Ship] Fixed an issue where the RX91 skill couldn't damage the hatcheries.
[Ship] Fixed an issue with the RX91 damage calculation being abnormal.
[Ship] Fixed an issue where RX91 could constantly accumulate energy by hitting an asteroid once.
[Ship] Fixed an issue with PMT34's active skill not dealing damage.
[Card] Fixed an issue with some descriptions of the funnel_missile being incorrect.
[Card] Fixed an issue where funnel_missile_adv could not receive bonuses from drone cards.
[Card] Fixed an issue with the range of funnel_hole's attraction.
[Card] Fixed an issue where clicking the D key while renaming a deck would remove cards.


What's next?
We are still working hard to resolve existing bugs, such as beam weapon drop, abnormal health display, and so on. We will also consider optimizing the game's operation and rhythm, such as the UI of the card selection interface, or changes similar to the Asteroids refresh rate mentioned earlier.
New content is also under consideration, but it won't arrive soon. We are conceptualizing a new mode to integrate card building and ship gameplay more closely.

Join Discord and give me feedback
Join Discord to give us feedback, and you'll be able to exchange gameplay tips with players worldwide. Of course, you can also give your comments and suggestions in the Latest Feedback Post in the steam community.
Finally, once again, thank you to everyone who is still playing the game, for your love and patience

notes.title: Erabit takes over content updates and bug fixes
notes.notes:
👋Hello everyone! This is Liya from Erabit. We assist the solo developer Ken with publishing Star Survivor.

It's been a while since our last official announcement in December 2023. First, I apologize for the long silence. Here's an update on what we've been working on over the past six months.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/47a9623f8074dc9d5fb4ea1015aa3e0fda218d57.png

Erabit is now taking over the maintenance and updates for Star Survivor
Due to Ken's busy schedule and personal challenges, he has found it difficult to maintain the game. After discussing it, Ken entrusted Star Survivor to Erabit. Following his design ideas and roadmap, we will continue to fix the game's issues and add new content. Actually, we already have a substantial content update planned.

Fixing existing issues
We have reviewed your feedback and comments, identified the most critical bugs, and have already begun fixing them. You can see these fixes in the latest game update:

 Memory leak: The mobile porting team has resolved this issue, and we are now porting the fix back to the PC version. Soon, you won't have to restart the game every 30 minutes.
 Beam weapon bug: Fixed an issue where beam weapons wouldn't hit enemies when the ship was rotating.
 Frame drops with controllers: Fixed a problem causing severe frame drops after using a controller.
 Enemy freeze bug: Fixed a bug causing enemies to freeze and stop moving.
 Achievement adjustments: Adjusted the values of achievements so they could be regained.


We also have some planned fixes that you will see in future update announcements.

New game content
In addition to ongoing maintenance, we will also add new content and optimizations based on Ken's design ideas: optimized UI displays, new cards, new spaceships, and more. When we're ready, we'll recruit tester players from the Steam community and Discord. Stay tuned!

Leaving Early Access
Early Access has helped Star Survivor become a better game, and we are very grateful for your support. As previously mentioned, we believe the game content is nearly complete (although some bugs still need fixing, which we will address soon). We plan to exit Early Access very soon. This does not mean the end of game maintenance but rather a new beginning. We will release a new content pack that marks the end of Early Access, featuring new ships, a ship skin system, new cards, and a new challenge mode.

Finally, we want to thank everyone who continues to play the game. We appreciate your love and patience 

Best regards, 
Liya ❤️

notes.title: 3 months of game polishing - Update for the main branch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/666bb01342df2fda3e82f13a689f0a1c319684c1.gif
A little backstory...
The Unity pro developer dived into my source code and said the general structure of the game was illogical and it would take months to fix the whole thing. Good news, I know what are the next steps to polish the game ASAP. The next stop - fixing the Object Pool and Particles.

Meanwhile, there is a major Steam event for the games like Star Survivor. Visit Bullet Heaven Fest for more discounts, demos, and new games announcements.

The full list of the last 3 months' fixes migrating to the main branch:

The latest thingies
- New game icons published
- Increased chicken highlight
- Fixed combo notice for already comboed weapons
- Reduced charging enemies charge speed by 25%
- Forced cooldown on elite enemies' special attacks so they cannot perform the attack as they spawn
- Increased projectile pool limit from 200 to 500

Pew-pews
- fixed shield, tagging and tesla coil upgrades not showing in Upgrades when choosing category in campaign
- fixed orbital mines losing collision
- fixed fighters being detached if bay was replaced or combined
- fixed quadrant equipment upgrades not applying to the new equipment
- fixed shields picking up items
Gacha fun
- reduced the weight on reroll cards — less chance to see the same cards on consecutive attempts
- removed replaced equipment from history to prevent replaced equipment (now non-applicable) upgrades being drawn
- choosing a card in a campaign no longer removes that card from the draw pool during that stage
- fixed empty deck campaign issue
- fixed incinerator not trigging beam card draws
Better menus
- fixed keyboard shortcuts triggered while renaming the deck
- fixed add card filters being toggled while typing in search
- fixed challenge map select issue
- fixed being able to select the current hex'
- max zoom out distance changed from 70 to 60
- UI performance optimizations
- added a notification when hate increases
- fixed campaign stage depth not reflecting on starting hate
Strong Doge
- increased exp rewards for higher tier enemies
- adjusted exp scale to be closer to original but still taper off at a higher level
- adjusted exp curve from +20% per level to +35% - 1% per level.
Originally the exp needed to level increased by 20% each time to level (exponential). This update will flatten the curve so that the exp needed will be +35% at level 1 (at the beginning and decreasing as you level), so by level 35, the exp required to level will be the same and no longer increasing.
More goodies
- asteroid drops are more dynamic, and the drop rate of anything is still at 4%, but the selection will be determined by the game's increased bomber instances from - 50 to 100
- created new pickup: damage buff (orange orb) - will double all weapon damage for 10 seconds (timer can be increased with general upgrade)
- green orb pickup range now covers the entire map
- fixed DS9 not picking up exp
The badies
- elites now drop only blue or orange orbs
- reduced amount of spawned enemies
- increased hate generation from 0.25 -> 0.5 per kill
- increased enemy hate health bonus from 0.15 to 0.25
- replaced damage number system with a more performant simplified version
- fixed enemy not seeking player
Gasy things
- enemy ground gas now has a visual indicator of when damage is applied and will disable itself
- added ground gas delay so they will not do damage immediately when spawned
Rebalancing
- starting reroll cost reduced from 5 to 3.
- shotgun starting firepoint 4 to 5
- teslacoil cooldown reduced 2 to 1.5 sec
- ion trident tighten firing arc from 30 degrees to 15, base damage increased from 10 to 15
- railgun base damage increased from 20 to 40, cooldown reduced from 5 to 3 sec
- flak turret base damage increased from 7 to 10, base radius increased from 1 to 2, added base 25% burn chance
- flak cannon base damage increased 15 to 20, base radius increased 2 to 3, and narrowed fire pattern from 30 to 20 degrees
- auto turret, removed starting burn chance
- particle collider now starts with 100% pierce, pierce upgrade card removed
- black hole generator now starts with 100% pierce, deals damage to enemies at the center
- spiral ion disk starts with 5 base damage
- cruise missile damage radius increased from 1 to 2
- rocket barrage removed ground fire chance, decreased cooldown from 4 to 1.5
- fighters base speed increased from 3 to 4
- tesla orb base damage increased 10 to 15
- ion fence now spawns 5m away in the quadrant direction
- proxy mine starting life increased from 5 to 7 sec, damage radius increased from 2 to 3
- orbital mines start with 8 max drones, and deployment speed changed from 4 to 3 sec
- god beam removed the starting burn chance, cooldown increased from 5 to 6
- god strike damage increased 10 to 20, and cooldown reduced from 3 to 2
- turrets of the same type will no longer target the same enemy if able
- fixed tesla attack speed not applying to tesla orb
- fixed bomber instances being capped at 40

THANK YOU, EVERYONE, FOR LEAVING REVIEWS OR FEEDBACK
I try to look for feedback everywhere, but I might not always reply to you. Yet, seeing your reviews allowed me to identify the things that need to be polished more.

notes.title: Recent Update Feedback & Good news
notes.notes:
Hello friends!
It is Ken, a single person behind the Star Survivor. Last 2 weeks I was occupied with moving to a new place, and now I am back to the game :)

Negative Reviews
A few days ago I returned to see so many bad reviews. The situation made me sad, it got my guts full of spite and sorrow — I am just one person. And I wronged so many people. Yet, it is people who were disappointed by my product that are to be sympathized with. And I am the only person who could make it right.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/236973d3242def3e3ba058fb7293d29415d616e6.gif
Performance

After taking some thinking, here is the plan for further action:
I asked the porting coder, and he told me how to fix garbage collection, code strings, and UI. In theory, it should help with the memory leak. In practice, he sent me articles in Chinese, and it takes time and Google Translate to digest the info. 
Design
Some combo' design seems to be punishing. The ULTRA knockback on God Strikes shooting enemies onto you at light speed. Or un-hittable enemies with fear getting frozen status, leading to you not knowing that there is no collision damage with them... I am re-working these now 😳
Technical
It is my 1st time adding controller support to the game, and I missed the menu navigation part...💀 For now, I deleted the mention of controller support till I fix it. The demand for key re-bind and the Steam Deck was also a shock. Do many bullet heavens have those? I am really sorry, I put those in the future plans 🙏🏻

Good News
Steam items - Trading Cards
As a small bonus for you spending time in the game and getting all those timing achievements, I got the Steam Trading Cards for you. I hope you like the badges, emoticons, and backgrounds! Or if not, you could just try to sell those😢
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/2355cd15184e2a5411cd4c34fbd110845845be9e.png
Mobile port
This month the porting team will do the playtest on TapTap China. Later it will hit other global platforms. The interface feels really mini at the moment, but having a game you made on the phone is so extraterrestrial🌌
[Link TapTap]

Conclusion
There are many things to be done yet, and I am grateful for your support and trust! I won't ask you to leave good reviews or rewrite negative ones, though it does make Steam show Star Survivor to fewer people. But if you have any support words, advice, or info in bugs, please leave a comment here, or write me on Discord ❤️

THANK YOU!
- Commander Ken

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.notes:
Major Update! New Boss, Combo Weapons and Bug Fixes!🥳

💋 Thank you for supporting Star Survivor. All feedback from Steam reviews and Discord immensely helped with the game development!

It has been a month since the Early Access release. Daily work without days off was bringing Star Survivor so many small patches that we finally arrived at Step 1 before the full release~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/35cdff18bac8a53d23024cfc69a5f6ea7477fc41.gif

The latest progress is toward Combo Weapons. When equipping a weapon, a highlight will appear over a previously equipped item if it is part of the combo pair. Clicking on this slot will open the combo screen instead of the replacement screen. Accepting will equip a new combo weapon in that slot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/3d8e9581baa109d576efdebc5fb586d040b30c0c.gif

Currently have 4 pairs right now, and more in progress. Please, try those out & tell me what you think:
 Atom Beam + Auto Burst Turret = Point Defense
 Particle Collider + Railgun = Black Hole
 Bullet Sphere + Tesla Coil = Tesla Orb
 Auto Turret + Shield = Segmented Shield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/59f70f44b9c8a6d4f358f088457ab26898b60c9e.jpg

New Spike Boss
A super version of the spiky mob, now with 100% more spikes! Did I mention it shoots spikes at you?

notes.title: Controls Update
notes.notes:
Hello, first update!
Been reviewing your feedback and many players have been struggling with the controls. I have added a new control settings screen in the main menu that will allow you to adjust and test alternative control schemes and allow for controller support:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597184/36846a3ef8180772f3a596f01a9f953cfb73d074.jpg

Movement:
- Screen Relative: Use WASD or Left Controler Stick to maneuver your ship relative to the screen. Ex: W (up) will move the ship upwards towards the top screen regardless of the ship heading.
- Ship Relative: Use WASD or Left Controler Stick to maneuver relative to the orientation of the ship itself. Ex: A (left) will move to the ship's left (portside).

Rotation:
- Relative: Use Left/Right arrows or Right Controller Stick to turn your ship relative to itself. Ex: Left arrow will turn the ship left.
- Directional Align: Use Arrows keys or Right Controller Stick to turn the ship to face that direction. Ex: Up Arrow (up) will turn the ship to point upwards towards the top of the screen.
- Mouse Align: Use mouse to turn the ship to face that direction. Ex: The ship will point towards the mouse.

Other changes:
- Removed cost for removing starting cards
- Added deck minimum (30 cards)
- Added starting weaker enemy
- Increased health for larger advanced enemies
- Fixed strafing enemy movement
- Added upgrade powerup drop - free upgrade on pickup
- Deduced currency drop rate for burn and ion damage on asteroids
- Fixed cargo arm card increasing projectile radius
- Reduced pickup sound effect

Next: New enemy types/patterns and reworking weapons to allow for more consistent exp gain to level up instead of simply running from the enemies at later stages during a round.
